correctness.rationale: The semidefinite sandwich and permutation averaging prove unrestricted global reduction to block-constant scaling. The four eigenvalue formulas follow from invariant subspaces, the monotonicities fix the minimax interval, and the polynomial collision identities yield the closed-form clipped optimum. Exact rational 4x4 spectral identities and repeated finite tests support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: A natural two-community covariance/preconditioning family with arbitrarily many coordinates admits an explicit size-aware exact optimizer despite four competing eigenmodes. The scale can sit at a collision of a fluctuating mode with a quotient mode; a two-dimensional quotient-only analysis can be wrong. The 4x4 rational example exhibits a strict exact improvement over Jacobi. This is a nontrivial structural classification and reproducible test case, not a relabeling or numeric-only benchmark.
